findings.title: Crash-resume silently double-skips cohort names -> a resumed scored cell would compute books missing ~2x names_done names (silent wrong verdict)
findings.evidence: e_stream_run.py:381-384 builds it_a = stream_iter_names(ctx, CACHE_DIR, skip=ckpt_pass_a.names_done) AND CheckpointablePassA.__init__ (i_stream_engine.py:1310-1313) sets self.names_done from the SAME checkpoint; CheckpointablePassA.run then drops the first names_done names of that ALREADY-skipped iterator (i_stream_engine.py:1366-1369 'if self.names_done > 0: self.names_done -= 1; continue'). Net effect: names fed+1 .. 2*fed never enter the accumulators or the fired-date/PIT/reversal census, with NO error. Identical composition for pass B (e_stream_run.py:398-405 with CheckpointablePassB.run :1509-1511). The selfcheck only tests the single-skip composition (selfcheck.py:246-249 feeds the FULL iterator to ck2.run), so the committed tests cannot catch this.
findings.impact: any cell resumed after a mid-pass crash (checkpoint_every=256, so fed>=256) produces silently wrong books/verdict while still consuming the slot and writing an atomic DONE verdict - the exact silent-corruption class the remediation was meant to eliminate
findings.fix_direction: drop one of the two skip layers (pass-level names_done skip is sufficient and is the selfchecked path; or pass skip=0 and rely on stream-level skip); add a resume-composition test feeding an already-skipped iterator

findings.title: Scored launcher crashes unconditionally at startup: KeyError 'dispatch_base'
findings.evidence: e_stream_run.py:489-490 logs env['dispatch_base'], but p0_env()'s returned record (e_stream_run.py:185-191) contains only head/branch/code_freeze_files/code_freeze_ok/branch_ok/porcelain/tracked_dirty/shadow_workers - there is no 'dispatch_base' key anywhere. The KeyError fires on EVERY scored launch, after p0_env() but before p1_lock() and outside the try/finally (which starts at :497), so it propagates uncaught.
findings.impact: the committed scored path cannot execute; it fails closed (no lock held, no verdict written, GO phrase never consumed, no scored computation), but a prelaunch GO would be wasted and die unconsumed; the lane is not launchable as committed
findings.fix_direction: log head only (or add the intended base field to the p0_env record); one-line-class fix

findings.title: DSR gate is wired with trial_sharpes=[] making the survivor terminal outcome structurally unreachable and undisclosed
findings.evidence: e_stream_run.py:430-432 calls adjudicate.dsr_gate(book_log, [], 47, 0.10, allow_scored=True); research/dsr.py:96-103 returns dsr=None reason='insufficient_trials' for <2 trial Sharpes, and dsr_gate then computes pass=False (adjudicate.py:547)
findings.impact: no cell can ever be appended to survivors, so STOCKS_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY_R0_NOT_RUN_PBO_NOT_RUN is unreachable under the committed wiring; direction is fail-closed (never a false survivor) and the REJECT_ALL/INCOMPLETE outcomes remain valid, but the limitation is nowhere disclosed in README/dispatch
findings.fix_direction: wire a declared trial-sharpe source for the 3-cell regime (or prewrite the insufficient_trials disposition as the frozen DSR outcome for this cycle and disclose it)

findings.title: Checkpoint JSON lacks fsync (process-crash-safe, not power-loss-durable); worst case is a consistent resume from generation g-1
findings.evidence: _atomic_json (i_stream_engine.py:1271-1277) uses tmp+write+os.replace without fsync, while accum snapshots (:328-337) and spill writers (:208-218) DO fsync. A machine crash that loses the ckpt rename leaves the previous ckpt naming gen g-1 whose accum file is retained (two newest kept, :338-344), so resume is consistent and reprocesses names - safe, only wasted work. Relevant only if a scored cell is resumed after a full-machine crash
